paite: Mipi bang a om kua ahia? Huan thil hilhchetna kua ahia thei? Mihing pilna in amai avaksak a, amai takna akikheng hi.
K'on thuhilh, Pathian thuchiam lam thu ah, kumpipa thupiak zui in.
heading: Kumpipa Thu Mang In

paite: A-omna mun a kipan paikhe ding in kinoh ke'n; thil gilou ah engtat ke'n; ama'n lah a-utut ahih sek ngal a,
Kumpipa thu in thilhihtheihna aneih ziak in, "Bang ahia na hih?" Kua'n ahia akiang achi thei ding?
Thupiak zuite'n thil gilou athei kei ding uh; huan mipil lungtang in hun leh vaihawmna atheikhen zel.
Thiltup chiteng ah lah hun leh vaihawmna a-om ngal a; mihing haksatna lah atung ah athupi ngal a.
Ahong om ding lah athei ngal kei a; bangchi in a-om dia chih amah kua'n ahilh thei dia le?

Kha lentang ding in kha tung a thilhihtheihna neimi a-om kei; sihna ni tung ah leng thilhihtheihna anei sam kei. Huan huai kidouna ah panna a-om kei; piak a om gitlouhna in amah ahunkhe sam kei ding hi.
Hiai tengteng ka mu a, nasep chiteng ni nuai a hih ah ka lungtang ka pia a; asiatna ding in mi khat in midang tung a thilhihtheihna aneih louh hun a-om hi.
heading: Migilou Leh Midiktat

paite: Huan giloute vui a om ka mu lai a, huan han ah ahong ua; huchi in hihdikte mun siangthou a kipan apaimang ua, khopi ah mangngilh in a-om uhi; hiai leng bangmah lou ahi.
Gilou nasep kintak a gawtna akibawl louh ziak in, huaiziak in mite tapate lungtang gilou hih ding in huai ah koihkip in a-om hi.
Mikhial in gilou zakhat vei hih in, anite hihsau mahleh, Pathian kihta mite amau a ding in ahoih ding chih ka thei mahmah hi, ama a laudan siamte.
Himahleh giloute a ding in ahoih kei ding, anite leng asausak kei ding a, huai lah limliap bang ahi; Pathian ma a laudan asiam louh ziak in.

Bangmah lou leitung a hih a om a-om a; midiktat omta bang hileh leng, ama tung a migilou nasep dungzui in ahong om nak hi; huai lou in migiloute omta bang hileh leng, midiktatte nasep dungzui in atung uah ahong om hi; hiai leng bangmah lou ahi.

Nek leh dawn a vualnuam a om kan a ni nuai a mihing in thil hoihzaw aneih louh ziak in, vualnopna ka phat hi. Pathian in amah ni nuai a apiak adamsung ni tengteng a asepgimna ah amah toh om gige ding ahi ngal a.
Pilna thei ding leh leitung a hih a om thu-le-la mu ding a ka lungtang ka suk lai in; sun hiam zan hiam a mit a ihmut muh louh lah a-om ngal a.

Huchi in Pathian thilhih tengteng ka mu a, huchi in ni nuai a thilhih mihing in amukhe thei kei hi; zongkhe ding in mihing nakpitak in pang lezong, amuh louh ding ziak in; huai lou in, mipil in thei kisa mahleh, amukhe thei kei ding hi.
